QuestInfo.name: Special Training Field Trip
QuestInfo.1: The headmaster says that you need to participate in a Special Training Field Trip--it must be #banother Resistance mission#k! Hurry to the #bUnderground Base#k and talk to #b#p2151002#, the Wild Hunter Job Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have a new, difficult Resistance mission that must be completed at the Power Plant, the hideout of the Black Wings. Although it will be tough, you have no desire to forfeit!
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 60, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.

0.1: Now, we have a #bSpecial Training Field Trip#k planned for students who have shown outstanding achievements. I'd like to encourage you to participate.

yes.0: Your #bhomeroom teacher#k will hold the Special Training Field Trip in the classroom, #h0#. Head to the #bschool#k and find out what the field trip entails. I look forward to seeing your progress.

no.0: Give the Field Trip a chance. It'll be quite enlightening, I promise.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. You've grown quite a bit since we last met. Level 60 already... Wonderful. It is such a delight to have a student like you.

1.1: Anyway, you're not here to chat. I have a mission for you, and it is not an easy one. So, you ready?

yes.0: I'll tell you more about the mission in a bit, but here are the basics. You have to leave Edelstein and head to the #bPower Plant the Black Wings use as their base#k, so make sure you have everything prepared.

npc.0: You haven't participated in the #bSpecial Training Field Trip#k yet? Hurry over to the #bSchool#k and find your classroom. Your #bhomeroom teacher#k will be waiting for you.
npc.1: #b(Special Training? It must be another Resistance mission! Go to the School and hurry over to the Resistance Underground Base to talk to #p2151002#!)#k

1.0: I can tell you've gotten stronger. You would be a valuable member of the police force if you joined, you know... If only those Black Wings weren't in the way...
